title: When Algorithmic Exploration Becomes Cheap: A Case Study of Agentic Research in EDA

paragraphs.en: As EDA researchers, we conducted eight deliberate trials of agentic algorithm exploration, selecting several topics outside our areas of depth. One faculty member and seven students participated, including students without publication experience. With limited intervention in the algorithms, agents developed mathematical constructions, analyzed existing tools, and implemented improvements; some efforts fell short of their practical goals. We also used AI to collect, classify, and analyze 8,420 papers from four EDA conferences and two journals over 2022–2026. Among 2,380 primary-core papers, we classified 97.7% from titles and abstracts as computationally closed, including work on new formulations. Together, these observations suggest that much of EDA offers an executable environment for increasingly accessible algorithm research. We see an opportunity for tool developers to investigate ideas they previously lacked time to pursue. We also ask how EDA should validate and reward research when results become easier to produce than to examine, and what papers and venue labels will continue to tell us about a contribution.
paragraphs.zh: 作为电子设计自动化（EDA）领域的研究人员，我们进行了八次有目的的智能体算法探索试验，并选择了几个我们并非深入研究的领域作为主题。 参与此次研究的一名教师成员和七名学生中，包括一些尚无论文发表经验的学生。 在对手动干预算法进行有限控制的情况下，智能体自行发展出数学构造、分析了现有工具并实施了改进；但部分尝试未能达到其实际目标。 我们还利用人工智能收集、分类和分析了 2022 年至 2026 年间来自四场 EDA 会议和两种期刊的 8,420 篇论文。 在 2,380 篇核心主论文中，我们通过标题和摘要将其中 97.7% 的论文归类为计算封闭型，包括涉及新公式的研究成果。 综合来看，这些观察结果表明，EDA 领域的很大一部分内容提供了一个可执行的环境，使算法研究变得越来越容易开展。 我们认为，这为工具开发者提供了一个机会，使他们能够研究此前因时间不足而无法深入探索的想法。 我们也提出疑问：当研究成果变得比审查结果更容易产出时，EDA 应当如何验证和奖励研究？哪些论文和发表渠道的标签仍能有效反映一项研究的贡献价值？

paragraphs.en: We were inspired by recent breakthroughs in AI-assisted mathematics, including new mathematical constructions and progress on research-level proof problems ( 10 , 11 , 12 ) . As EDA researchers, we wanted to find out how far similar exploration could go in our field. We organized eight deliberate Agentic Research Trials (ART), selecting several topics in which we had little prior depth. One faculty member and seven students participated. Some students had neither published a paper nor completed a research project from conception through publication. We specified demanding research questions and sought to interfere as little as possible with the algorithms used to answer them.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从近期人工智能辅助数学领域的突破中获得了启发，其中包括新的数学构造以及在研究级证明问题上的进展（10、11、12）。 作为电子设计自动化领域的研究人员，我们想探索类似的研究方法在该领域能推进到何种程度。 我们组织了八次有计划的智能体研究试验（ART），并挑选了几个我们此前缺乏深入研究经验的课题。 一名教师和七名学生参与了这项试验。 有些学生既没有发表过论文，也没有完成过从构思到发表的完整研究项目。 我们设定了具有挑战性的研究问题，并尽可能减少对用于解答这些问题的算法的干预。

sents.zh: 我们设定了具有挑战性的研究问题，并尽可能减少对用于解答这些问题的算法的干预。

paragraphs.en: The trials covered rooted rectilinear spanning trees, logic optimization, global placement, hypergraph contraction, clock-tree realizability, timing-aware remapping, timing-aware rewriting, and LUT-based FPGA optimization. We asked agents to construct guarantees, challenge conjectures, identify useful structure, or turn an idea into an implementation. We sometimes changed a question, supplied a direction, or rejected an inadequate comparison. We retained unsuccessful branches and unmet goals alongside the resulting constructions and tools.
paragraphs.zh: 这些试验涵盖了根式直线连通树、逻辑优化、全局布局、超图收缩、时钟树可实现性、时序感知重映射、时序感知重写以及基于查找表的 FPGA 优化。 我们要求智能体构建保证、挑战猜想、识别有用结构，或将一个想法转化为具体实现。 我们有时会修改问题、提供方向，或拒绝不充分的比较。 我们将未成功的分支和未达成的目标与最终生成的构造及工具一并保留。

sents.en: The trials covered rooted rectilinear spanning trees, logic optimization, global placement, hypergraph contraction, clock-tree realizability, timing-aware remapping, timing-aware rewriting, and LUT-based FPGA optimization.
sents.zh: 这些试验涵盖了根式直线连通树、逻辑优化、全局布局、超图收缩、时钟树可实现性、时序感知重映射、时序感知重写以及基于查找表的 FPGA 优化。

paragraphs.en: How far can a small EDA group explore an unfamiliar topic without supplying the algorithmic route?
paragraphs.zh: 在没有提供算法路径的情况下，一个小型 EDA 团队能对一个不熟悉的话题探索到何种程度？

paragraphs.en: Which results transfer from a proof or executable experiment into a useful tool?
paragraphs.zh: 哪些结果能够从证明或可执行实验中转化为实用工具？

paragraphs.en: How should EDA evaluate and recognize research as this exploration becomes less expensive?
paragraphs.zh: 随着这种探索的成本逐渐降低，EDA 应如何评估和识别研究？

paragraphs.en: The experiences changed our expectations about the specialist effort needed to begin an investigation. They also exposed a persistent gap between obtaining a technically valid result and improving a mature tool. Our interest is in using the new capacity to strengthen EDA research, with particular attention to how results transfer into real design tools (Fig. 1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 这些经验改变了我们对开展调查所需专业工作量的预期。 它们还揭示了获得技术上有效的结果与改进成熟工具之间持续存在的差距。 我们的兴趣在于利用这种新能力来加强 EDA 研究，尤其关注如何将研究结果应用于实际设计工具（图 1）。

sents.zh: 我们的兴趣在于利用这种新能力来加强 EDA 研究，尤其关注如何将研究结果应用于实际设计工具（图 1）。

paragraphs.en: Work in EDA already spans conversational hardware design, domain-adapted assistants, and autonomous tool orchestration ( 15 , 16 , 17 , 18 ) . ART extends the question to developing the algorithms inside a tool. The wider history of AI-assisted discovery ( 37 ) includes mathematical conjectures ( 38 ) , matrix multiplication ( 39 ) , and sorting routines integrated into LLVM ( 40 ) . FunSearch and AlphaEvolve use executable feedback for discovery ( 8 , 9 ) ; The AI Scientist explores end-to-end research production ( 14 ) . We paired our trials with an analysis of EDA’s publication record, asking how much research already has a computationally closed loop and what changes appear in its distribution.
paragraphs.zh: EDA领域的工作已经涵盖了对话式硬件设计、领域自适应助手以及自主工具编排（15，16，17，18）。 ART将问题扩展到了开发工具内部的算法。 AI辅助发现的更广泛历史（37）包括数学猜想（38）、矩阵乘法（39）以及集成到LLVM中的排序程序（40）。 FunSearch和AlphaEvolve利用可执行反馈进行发现（8，9）；The AI Scientist则探索了端到端的研究产出（14）。 我们将实验与对EDA出版物记录的分析相结合，旨在探究已有研究在多大程度上实现了计算闭环，以及其分布中出现了哪些变化。

sents.zh: FunSearch和AlphaEvolve利用可执行反馈进行发现（8，9）；The AI Scientist则探索了端到端的研究产出（14）。

sents.zh: 我们将实验与对EDA出版物记录的分析相结合，旨在探究已有研究在多大程度上实现了计算闭环，以及其分布中出现了哪些变化。

paragraphs.en: ART used sustained pressure and independent judgment to push agents beyond their first plausible answer. We set a demanding endpoint, judged each candidate against it, and sent inadequate results back for further work. Participants used different prompts, tools, and divisions of labor. The shared approach was to constrain what would count as a result while leaving the algorithmic route open (Fig. 2 ).
paragraphs.zh: ART 通过持续施压和独立判断，促使智能体超越其最初合理的回答。 我们设定了一个高要求的终点标准，据此评估每个候选方案，并将不充分的成果退回以进行进一步处理。 参与者使用了不同的提示词、工具和分工方式。 共同采用的方法是：限定哪些内容可被视为有效结果，同时保留算法路径的开放性（图 2）。

sents.en: ART used sustained pressure and independent judgment to push agents beyond their first plausible answer.
sents.zh: ART 通过持续施压和独立判断，促使智能体超越其最初合理的回答。

sents.en: We set a demanding endpoint, judged each candidate against it, and sent inadequate results back for further work.
sents.zh: 我们设定了一个高要求的终点标准，据此评估每个候选方案，并将不充分的成果退回以进行进一步处理。

sents.en: Participants used different prompts, tools, and divisions of labor.
sents.zh: 参与者使用了不同的提示词、工具和分工方式。

sents.en: The shared approach was to constrain what would count as a result while leaving the algorithmic route open (Fig. 2 ).
sents.zh: 共同采用的方法是：限定哪些内容可被视为有效结果，同时保留算法路径的开放性（图 2）。

paragraphs.en: We began from the possibility that an apparently settled problem had exhausted the community’s attention rather than its mathematical opportunities. An agent was asked to revisit its foundations: derive a construction, challenge a bound, find a counterexample, or identify the precise obstruction. Familiar methods were available for comparison, but were not the prescribed destination.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从这样一种可能性出发：一个看似已经解决的问题，或许只是耗尽了整个学术界的关注，而非其数学上的探索空间。 我们要求智能体重新审视其基础：推导一种构造、挑战一个界限、找到一个反例，或识别出精确的阻碍因素。 虽然已有熟悉的方法可供比较，但它们并非指定的目标方向。

sents.zh: 我们从这样一种可能性出发：一个看似已经解决的问题，或许只是耗尽了整个学术界的关注，而非其数学上的探索空间。

sents.zh: 虽然已有熟悉的方法可供比较，但它们并非指定的目标方向。

paragraphs.en: We used explicit premises to sustain this search. Instructions such as The final goal is achievable discouraged an early retreat to a survey or an account of why the task was difficult. Other branches added Previously explored approaches cannot reach the final goal to force a departure from familiar routes. These were search instructions, not assumptions that could be inserted into a proof.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用明确的预设前提来维持这种搜索。 诸如“最终目标是可实现的”之类的指令，会阻止人们过早地转向探索或解释任务为何困难。 其他分支则补充道：“先前探索的方法无法达到最终目标”，以此迫使人们偏离熟悉的路线。 这些是搜索指令，而非可以插入证明中的假设。

sents.zh: 我们使用明确的预设前提来维持这种搜索。

sents.zh: 其他分支则补充道：“先前探索的方法无法达到最终目标”，以此迫使人们偏离熟悉的路线。

paragraphs.en: The interaction was deliberately adversarial at the point of acceptance. We rejected candidates that answered an easier question, offered a convenient special case, or repackaged a familiar method without meeting the goal. A technically correct intermediate result could be retained while the agent was still required to continue. Pressure concerned the result it had to reach; prescribing a sequence of named algorithms would have undermined the attempt to explore non-mainstream alternatives.
paragraphs.zh: 在接受环节，这种互动是刻意带有对抗性的。 对于那些回答更简单问题、提出便捷的特殊情况，或只是重新包装了熟悉的方法却未达成目标的候选者，我们都予以拒绝。 即使技术正确的中间结果得以保留，智能体仍然需要继续执行任务。 压力在于必须达到的结果；如果预先规定一系列命名算法，就会破坏探索非主流替代方案的努力。

sents.zh: 在接受环节，这种互动是刻意带有对抗性的。

paragraphs.en: We treated three elements as necessary to this method:
paragraphs.zh: 我们将三个要素视为该方法所必需的：

paragraphs.en: A substantive gate. The gate specified what counted as reaching the goal. A theory task might require a general construction and its guarantee; an engineering task might require an actual implementation to improve a fixed comparison. Narrowing the input class or substituting a proxy did not silently change that gate. Such changes required an explicit decision about the question.
paragraphs.zh: 一个实质性的门限。 该门限界定了何种情况才算达成目标。 理论任务可能需要一个通用构造及其保证；而工程任务则可能需要实际实现来改进固定的比较方式。 缩小输入类别或替换代理并不会悄无声息地改变这个门限。 此类变更需要对相关问题做出明确的决策。

sents.en: A substantive gate.
sents.zh: 一个实质性的门限。

sents.en: The gate specified what counted as reaching the goal.
sents.zh: 该门限界定了何种情况才算达成目标。

sents.en: Such changes required an explicit decision about the question.
sents.zh: 此类变更需要对相关问题做出明确的决策。

paragraphs.en: An independent evaluator. A candidate’s author did not decide whether it passed. Engineering comparisons used separately prepared scoring and feasibility checks that the candidate could not rewrite. Theory work faced independent attempts to refute the argument, test its scope, and identify prior results. The object judged was the proof or running implementation, not the agent’s description of it.
paragraphs.zh: 一位独立评估者。 候选人的作者并未决定该方案是否通过。 工程比较使用了单独准备的评分和可行性检查，候选人无法改写这些内容。 理论工作面临了独立的尝试，旨在反驳论点、检验其范围并识别已有成果。 被评判的对象是证明或运行中的实现，而非智能体对其的描述。

sents.en: An independent evaluator.
sents.zh: 一位独立评估者。

sents.en: A candidate’s author did not decide whether it passed.
sents.zh: 候选人的作者并未决定该方案是否通过。

sents.en: Engineering comparisons used separately prepared scoring and feasibility checks that the candidate could not rewrite.
sents.zh: 工程比较使用了单独准备的评分和可行性检查，候选人无法改写这些内容。

sents.en: Theory work faced independent attempts to refute the argument, test its scope, and identify prior results.
sents.zh: 理论工作面临了独立的尝试，旨在反驳论点、检验其范围并识别已有成果。

sents.en: The object judged was the proof or running implementation, not the agent’s description of it.
sents.zh: 被评判的对象是证明或运行中的实现，而非智能体对其的描述。

paragraphs.en: Long autonomous attempts. Agents had time to pursue and abandon successive approaches without asking a human to direct each step. Several campaigns required at least eight hours of substantive work and acceptance of the goal before stopping. Eight hours was a minimum, not a deadline at which an incomplete result became acceptable.
paragraphs.zh: 长时间的自主尝试。 智能体有足够的时间去追求和放弃连续的方法，而无需人类指导每一步。 几次行动在停止前，至少需要八小时的实际工作和对目标的接受。 八小时是最短时长，而不是一个使未完成的结果变得可接受的截止日期。

sents.en: Long autonomous attempts.
sents.zh: 长时间的自主尝试。

sents.en: Agents had time to pursue and abandon successive approaches without asking a human to direct each step.
sents.zh: 智能体有足够的时间去追求和放弃连续的方法，而无需人类指导每一步。

sents.en: Several campaigns required at least eight hours of substantive work and acceptance of the goal before stopping.
sents.zh: 几次行动在停止前，至少需要八小时的实际工作和对目标的接受。

sents.zh: 八小时是最短时长，而不是一个使未完成的结果变得可接受的截止日期。

paragraphs.en: Together, these requirements separated exploration from the authority to declare completion. An agent could search broadly, but a polished explanation or a large volume of activity did not pass the gate. The gate governed acceptance of a result, not a checklist that every exploratory step had to clear.
paragraphs.zh: 这些要求共同将探索与宣布完成的权利区分开来。 智能体可以广泛搜索，但精辟的解释或大量活动都无法通过这道关卡。 这道关卡决定的是结果是否被接受，而非一个每个探索步骤都必须满足的检查清单。

sents.en: Together, these requirements separated exploration from the authority to declare completion.
sents.zh: 这些要求共同将探索与宣布完成的权利区分开来。

sents.en: An agent could search broadly, but a polished explanation or a large volume of activity did not pass the gate.
sents.zh: 智能体可以广泛搜索，但精辟的解释或大量活动都无法通过这道关卡。

sents.en: The gate governed acceptance of a result, not a checklist that every exploratory step had to clear.
sents.zh: 这道关卡决定的是结果是否被接受，而非一个每个探索步骤都必须满足的检查清单。

paragraphs.en: The organizing logic was to start with the underlying objects, objectives, and theoretical limits, then progressively tighten the demands on a useful algorithm. We sought structural explanations before settling into parameter tuning. A failed conjecture could reveal a missing condition; a new condition could suggest a construction; a construction could expose a computational component worth implementing.
paragraphs.zh: 其组织逻辑是：首先从底层对象、目标和理论限制出发，然后逐步提高对有效算法的要求。 在着手参数调整之前，我们试图寻找结构性的解释。 一个失败的猜想可能揭示出某个缺失的条件；一个新的条件可能启发某种构造方法；而一种构造方法则可能暴露出值得实现的计算组件。

sents.en: The organizing logic was to start with the underlying objects, objectives, and theoretical limits, then progressively tighten the demands on a useful algorithm.
sents.zh: 其组织逻辑是：首先从底层对象、目标和理论限制出发，然后逐步提高对有效算法的要求。

sents.en: We sought structural explanations before settling into parameter tuning.
sents.zh: 在着手参数调整之前，我们试图寻找结构性的解释。

sents.en: A failed conjecture could reveal a missing condition; a new condition could suggest a construction; a construction could expose a computational component worth implementing.
sents.zh: 一个失败的猜想可能揭示出某个缺失的条件；一个新的条件可能启发某种构造方法；而一种构造方法则可能暴露出值得实现的计算组件。

paragraphs.en: As work moved toward engineering, the requirements became more concrete: preserve the intended semantics, implement the mechanism, make it scale, and improve the complete computation under the independent evaluator. Agents could then repeatedly modify code, compile it, measure the result, and revise or replace the algorithm. Engineering feedback could also send the investigation back to its mathematical model. The progression was therefore iterative, rather than a one-way handoff from proof to code.
paragraphs.zh: 随着工作逐渐转向工程实现，需求也变得更加具体：保留预期的语义、实现机制、确保可扩展性，并在独立评估器下优化完整的计算过程。 智能体随后可以反复修改代码、编译代码、测量结果，并修订或替换算法。 工程反馈也可以将研究重新引导回其数学模型。 因此，这一过程是迭代的，而非从证明到代码的单次单向移交。

sents.en: As work moved toward engineering, the requirements became more concrete: preserve the intended semantics, implement the mechanism, make it scale, and improve the complete computation under the independent evaluator.
sents.zh: 随着工作逐渐转向工程实现，需求也变得更加具体：保留预期的语义、实现机制、确保可扩展性，并在独立评估器下优化完整的计算过程。

sents.en: Agents could then repeatedly modify code, compile it, measure the result, and revise or replace the algorithm.
sents.zh: 智能体随后可以反复修改代码、编译代码、测量结果，并修订或替换算法。

sents.en: Engineering feedback could also send the investigation back to its mathematical model.
sents.zh: 工程反馈也可以将研究重新引导回其数学模型。

sents.en: The progression was therefore iterative, rather than a one-way handoff from proof to code.
sents.zh: 因此，这一过程是迭代的，而非从证明到代码的单次单向移交。

paragraphs.en: The realization varied with the question. A theoretical branch could end with an accepted theorem or obstruction, while an engineering branch still had to show useful behavior in a running tool. Some agents could search the literature and inspect open-source implementations directly; others requested focused surveys through an organizer. What remained common was sustained pressure to find a stronger route, including alternatives outside the dominant approach, followed by increasingly concrete tests of whether that route delivered the intended result.
paragraphs.zh: 具体实现因问题而异。 理论分支可能以被接受的定理或障碍为终点，而工程分支则仍需在实际运行的工具中展现出有用行为。 一些智能体能够直接搜索文献并检查开源实现；另一些则通过组织者请求有针对性的调查。 共同点在于持续的压力：需要寻找更优的路径，包括主流方法之外的替代方案，随后还需通过越来越具体的测试来验证该路径是否实现了预期结果。

sents.en: The realization varied with the question.
sents.zh: 具体实现因问题而异。

sents.en: A theoretical branch could end with an accepted theorem or obstruction, while an engineering branch still had to show useful behavior in a running tool.
sents.zh: 理论分支可能以被接受的定理或障碍为终点，而工程分支则仍需在实际运行的工具中展现出有用行为。

sents.en: Some agents could search the literature and inspect open-source implementations directly; others requested focused surveys through an organizer.
sents.zh: 一些智能体能够直接搜索文献并检查开源实现；另一些则通过组织者请求有针对性的调查。

sents.en: What remained common was sustained pressure to find a stronger route, including alternatives outside the dominant approach, followed by increasingly concrete tests of whether that route delivered the intended result.
sents.zh: 共同点在于持续的压力：需要寻找更优的路径，包括主流方法之外的替代方案，随后还需通过越来越具体的测试来验证该路径是否实现了预期结果。

paragraphs.en: EDA makes these trials practical because many questions already have executable feedback. Logic transformations can be checked for equivalence. Placement and routing candidates have cost and feasibility tests. Timing engines and circuit simulators support repeatable comparisons. Public systems such as ABC, OpenROAD, DREAMPlace, and VTR provide substantial parts of this environment ( 19 , 20 , 21 , 41 ) .
paragraphs.zh: EDA 使这些试验变得可行，因为许多问题已经具备可执行的反馈机制。 逻辑转换的等价性可以进行检查。 布局与布线候选方案都具备成本与可行性测试。 时序引擎和电路模拟器支持重复进行的比较。 ABC、OpenROAD、DREAMPlace 和 VTR 等公开系统提供了该环境的很大一部分（19，20，21，41）。

sents.en: EDA makes these trials practical because many questions already have executable feedback.
sents.zh: EDA 使这些试验变得可行，因为许多问题已经具备可执行的反馈机制。

sents.en: Logic transformations can be checked for equivalence.
sents.zh: 逻辑转换的等价性可以进行检查。

sents.en: Placement and routing candidates have cost and feasibility tests.
sents.zh: 布局与布线候选方案都具备成本与可行性测试。

sents.en: Timing engines and circuit simulators support repeatable comparisons.
sents.zh: 时序引擎和电路模拟器支持重复进行的比较。

sents.en: Public systems such as ABC, OpenROAD, DREAMPlace, and VTR provide substantial parts of this environment ( 19 , 20 , 21 , 41 ) .
sents.zh: ABC、OpenROAD、DREAMPlace 和 VTR 等公开系统提供了该环境的很大一部分（19，20，21，41）。

paragraphs.en: Benchmarks supply another part. The ISPD placement contests, EPFL combinational suite, and OpenABC-D expose instances and comparisons around which later investigations can accumulate ( 42 , 43 , 44 , 45 ) . VerilogEval provides a related environment for generated hardware code ( 46 ) . Agents can enter a research loop without rebuilding its entire experimental setting.
paragraphs.zh: 基准测试提供了另一部分内容。 ISPD布局竞赛、EPFL组合电路套件以及OpenABC-D展示了实例和对比，后续研究可以围绕这些内容展开（42, 43, 44, 45）。 VerilogEval为生成的硬件代码提供了一个相关环境（46）。 智能体无需重建整个实验设置即可进入研究循环。

sents.en: Benchmarks supply another part.
sents.zh: 基准测试提供了另一部分内容。

sents.en: The ISPD placement contests, EPFL combinational suite, and OpenABC-D expose instances and comparisons around which later investigations can accumulate ( 42 , 43 , 44 , 45 ) .
sents.zh: ISPD布局竞赛、EPFL组合电路套件以及OpenABC-D展示了实例和对比，后续研究可以围绕这些内容展开（42, 43, 44, 45）。

sents.en: VerilogEval provides a related environment for generated hardware code ( 46 ) .
sents.zh: VerilogEval为生成的硬件代码提供了一个相关环境（46）。

sents.en: Agents can enter a research loop without rebuilding its entire experimental setting.
sents.zh: 智能体无需重建整个实验设置即可进入研究循环。

paragraphs.en: The cost of that loop still matters. A seconds-long equivalence check permits a different search from an hours-long physical-design flow. An industrial team may also have a strong executable environment unavailable to academics. We therefore expect agentic exploration to concentrate around particular problem–tool–benchmark combinations, not uniformly across whole conference tracks.
paragraphs.zh: 这种循环的成本仍然很重要。 持续一秒的等效性检查，其搜索方式会与持续数小时的物理设计流程不同。 工业团队可能还拥有学术界无法使用的强大可执行环境。 因此，我们预计智能体探索会集中在特定的问题–工具–基准组合上，而不是在整个会议主题中均匀分布。

sents.en: The cost of that loop still matters.
sents.zh: 这种循环的成本仍然很重要。

sents.en: A seconds-long equivalence check permits a different search from an hours-long physical-design flow.
sents.zh: 持续一秒的等效性检查，其搜索方式会与持续数小时的物理设计流程不同。

sents.en: An industrial team may also have a strong executable environment unavailable to academics.
sents.zh: 工业团队可能还拥有学术界无法使用的强大可执行环境。

sents.en: We therefore expect agentic exploration to concentrate around particular problem–tool–benchmark combinations, not uniformly across whole conference tracks.
sents.zh: 因此，我们预计智能体探索会集中在特定的问题–工具–基准组合上，而不是在整个会议主题中均匀分布。

paragraphs.en: Agents lowered the effort needed to enter unfamiliar topics, but progress depended strongly on what we asked them to achieve. A focused construction or implementation change could emerge quickly. Turning it into an advantage for a complete tool was harder. Across the eight trials, we saw this distinction repeatedly: in the questions that advanced, the checks that mattered, and the work that still remained after an encouraging first result.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体降低了进入不熟悉话题所需的努力，但进展在很大程度上取决于我们要求它们完成的任务。 一种专注的构建或实施上的改变可能很快就会出现。 要将其转化为完整工具的优势则更为困难。 在八次试验中，我们反复看到了这种区别：那些取得进展的问题、那些至关重要的检查项，以及在令人鼓舞的初步结果之后仍然需要完成的工作。

sents.en: Agents lowered the effort needed to enter unfamiliar topics, but progress depended strongly on what we asked them to achieve.
sents.zh: 智能体降低了进入不熟悉话题所需的努力，但进展在很大程度上取决于我们要求它们完成的任务。

sents.en: A focused construction or implementation change could emerge quickly.
sents.zh: 一种专注的构建或实施上的改变可能很快就会出现。

sents.en: Turning it into an advantage for a complete tool was harder.
sents.zh: 要将其转化为完整工具的优势则更为困难。

sents.en: Across the eight trials, we saw this distinction repeatedly: in the questions that advanced, the checks that mattered, and the work that still remained after an encouraging first result.
sents.zh: 在八次试验中，我们反复看到了这种区别：那些取得进展的问题、那些至关重要的检查项，以及在令人鼓舞的初步结果之后仍然需要完成的工作。

paragraphs.en: The rooted spanning-tree and logic-optimization trials began with different resources: a mathematical question and an existing codebase (Fig. 3 ). Both supported substantial exploration before we had mastered the relevant algorithmic route.
paragraphs.zh: 根树生成和逻辑优化试验以不同的资源开始：一个数学问题和一个现有的代码库（图 3）。 在我们掌握相关的算法路径之前，两者都支持了相当程度的探索。

sents.en: The rooted spanning-tree and logic-optimization trials began with different resources: a mathematical question and an existing codebase (Fig. 3 ).
sents.zh: 根树生成和逻辑优化试验以不同的资源开始：一个数学问题和一个现有的代码库（图 3）。

sents.en: Both supported substantial exploration before we had mastered the relevant algorithmic route.
sents.zh: 在我们掌握相关的算法路径之前，两者都支持了相当程度的探索。

paragraphs.en: In the tree problem, sharing edges saves total length but can lengthen the path from the root to a terminal. We asked for a rectilinear spanning tree balancing these objectives, without supplying a construction ( 1 ) . A counterexample invalidated an early proposed guarantee. The agents then developed a height-partition construction bounding both quantities within twice their respective lower bounds. We subsequently reconstructed the proof.
paragraphs.zh: 在树问题中，共享边可以节省总长度，但可能会延长从根节点到终端节点的路径。 我们要求一种能够平衡这些目标的矩形覆盖树，但没有提供具体的构造方法（ 1 ） 。 一个反例推翻了早期提出的一个保证。 随后，智能体们开发了一种高度分区构造方法，将这两个量都限制在各自下界的两倍以内。 接着，我们重新构建了该证明。

sents.en: In the tree problem, sharing edges saves total length but can lengthen the path from the root to a terminal.
sents.zh: 在树问题中，共享边可以节省总长度，但可能会延长从根节点到终端节点的路径。

sents.en: We asked for a rectilinear spanning tree balancing these objectives, without supplying a construction ( 1 ) .
sents.zh: 我们要求一种能够平衡这些目标的矩形覆盖树，但没有提供具体的构造方法（ 1 ） 。

sents.en: A counterexample invalidated an early proposed guarantee.
sents.zh: 一个反例推翻了早期提出的一个保证。

sents.en: The agents then developed a height-partition construction bounding both quantities within twice their respective lower bounds.
sents.zh: 随后，智能体们开发了一种高度分区构造方法，将这两个量都限制在各自下界的两倍以内。

sents.en: We subsequently reconstructed the proof.
sents.zh: 接着，我们重新构建了该证明。

paragraphs.en: Logic optimization began by asking what an existing implementation actually offered. The tool repeatedly applies transformations that preserve a circuit’s function while changing its structure. Agents traced relationships among those operations through the source. An exact Pareto argument reduced the menu from 40 actions to 31 ( 2 ) . Here, understanding the code was part of discovering the result, not merely preparation for implementing an idea we already had.
paragraphs.zh: 逻辑优化的第一步是探究现有实现究竟提供了什么。 该工具反复应用能够保持电路功能不变但改变其结构的转换。 智能体通过源代码追溯了这些操作之间的关系。 一个精确的帕累托论证将可选动作从 40 个减少到了 31 个（ 2 ） 。 在这里，理解代码是发现结果的一部分，而不仅仅是为了实施我们已有的想法所做的准备。

sents.en: Logic optimization began by asking what an existing implementation actually offered.
sents.zh: 逻辑优化的第一步是探究现有实现究竟提供了什么。

sents.en: The tool repeatedly applies transformations that preserve a circuit’s function while changing its structure.
sents.zh: 该工具反复应用能够保持电路功能不变但改变其结构的转换。

sents.en: Agents traced relationships among those operations through the source.
sents.zh: 智能体通过源代码追溯了这些操作之间的关系。

sents.en: An exact Pareto argument reduced the menu from 40 actions to 31 ( 2 ) .
sents.zh: 一个精确的帕累托论证将可选动作从 40 个减少到了 31 个（ 2 ） 。

sents.en: Here, understanding the code was part of discovering the result, not merely preparation for implementing an idea we already had.
sents.zh: 在这里，理解代码是发现结果的一部分，而不仅仅是为了实施我们已有的想法所做的准备。

paragraphs.en: The other trials required different amounts of prior human input. Remapping began inside an available framework; contraction began with a more detailed human formulation. We could delegate the search for a construction, the reconstruction of an implementation, or both. A participant’s shallow knowledge did not imply an empty starting point: the question, code, and benchmarks already carried considerable domain knowledge.
paragraphs.zh: 其他试验则需要不同程度的人类预先输入。 重新映射始于一个可用的框架；收缩则从一个更详细的人类表述开始。 我们可以将寻找结构、重构实现，或两者都委托给智能体。 参与者浅薄的知识并不意味着一个空白的起点：问题、代码和基准测试本身已经包含了相当多的领域知识。

sents.en: The other trials required different amounts of prior human input.
sents.zh: 其他试验则需要不同程度的人类预先输入。

sents.en: Remapping began inside an available framework; contraction began with a more detailed human formulation.
sents.zh: 重新映射始于一个可用的框架；收缩则从一个更详细的人类表述开始。

sents.en: We could delegate the search for a construction, the reconstruction of an implementation, or both.
sents.zh: 我们可以将寻找结构、重构实现，或两者都委托给智能体。

sents.en: A participant’s shallow knowledge did not imply an empty starting point: the question, code, and benchmarks already carried considerable domain knowledge.
sents.zh: 参与者浅薄的知识并不意味着一个空白的起点：问题、代码和基准测试本身已经包含了相当多的领域知识。

paragraphs.en: This changed the order of learning. Some students had never completed a research-to-publication cycle, yet could work with concrete proposals and failures while learning the subject. We increasingly learned by examining results that the agents had already developed. The reduced entry cost was therefore broader than faster coding: it made unfamiliar investigations practical for our small group.
paragraphs.zh: 这改变了学习的顺序。 有些学生从未完成过从研究到发表的完整周期，但在学习该学科时，他们却能处理具体的方案与失败。 我们越来越习惯于通过审视智能体已经生成的结果来进行学习。 因此，较低的入门成本带来的影响比编码速度更快更为广泛：它使我们这个小团队能够实际开展不熟悉的研究。

sents.en: This changed the order of learning.
sents.zh: 这改变了学习的顺序。

sents.en: Some students had never completed a research-to-publication cycle, yet could work with concrete proposals and failures while learning the subject.
sents.zh: 有些学生从未完成过从研究到发表的完整周期，但在学习该学科时，他们却能处理具体的方案与失败。

sents.en: We increasingly learned by examining results that the agents had already developed.
sents.zh: 我们越来越习惯于通过审视智能体已经生成的结果来进行学习。

sents.en: The reduced entry cost was therefore broader than faster coding: it made unfamiliar investigations practical for our small group.
sents.zh: 因此，较低的入门成本带来的影响比编码速度更快更为广泛：它使我们这个小团队能够实际开展不熟悉的研究。

paragraphs.en: Logic optimization and global placement are both mature fields. Their different trajectories point to the scope of the question, rather than the age of the field. Logic analysis could remove redundant choices inside an existing tool. Placement had to choose cell locations that jointly improved wirelength and density behavior, against highly developed methods such as ePlace, RePlAce, and DREAMPlace ( 47 , 48 , 21 ) . Its component results did not add up to the requested full-tool improvement.
paragraphs.zh: 逻辑优化和全局布局都是成熟的领域。 它们不同的发展轨迹指向了问题的范围，而非该领域的历史久远程度。 逻辑分析可以从现有工具中移除冗余的选择。 布局必须选择能够同时改善布线和密度表现的单元位置，而这一过程需要对抗 ePlace、RePlAce 和 DREAMPlace（47, 48, 21）等高度成熟的方法。 其各部分的结果相加并未达到所要求的完整工具性能提升。

sents.en: Logic optimization and global placement are both mature fields.
sents.zh: 逻辑优化和全局布局都是成熟的领域。

sents.en: Their different trajectories point to the scope of the question, rather than the age of the field.
sents.zh: 它们不同的发展轨迹指向了问题的范围，而非该领域的历史久远程度。

sents.en: Logic analysis could remove redundant choices inside an existing tool.
sents.zh: 逻辑分析可以从现有工具中移除冗余的选择。

sents.en: Placement had to choose cell locations that jointly improved wirelength and density behavior, against highly developed methods such as ePlace, RePlAce, and DREAMPlace ( 47 , 48 , 21 ) .
sents.zh: 布局必须选择能够同时改善布线和密度表现的单元位置，而这一过程需要对抗 ePlace、RePlAce 和 DREAMPlace（47, 48, 21）等高度成熟的方法。

sents.en: Its component results did not add up to the requested full-tool improvement.
sents.zh: 其各部分的结果相加并未达到所要求的完整工具性能提升。

paragraphs.en: We encountered two distinct sources of difficulty:
paragraphs.zh: 我们遇到了两个不同的困难来源：

paragraphs.en: A mathematically demanding endpoint. The tree approximation construction emerged in hours, while parallel requests for an exact polynomial-time solution remained unresolved. Broad placement requests also encountered complexity barriers.
paragraphs.zh: 一个数学上极具挑战性的终点。 树近似构造在数小时内便已出现，而并行请求的精确多项式时间解决方案却仍未解决。 广泛的放置请求也遭遇了复杂性障碍。

sents.en: A mathematically demanding endpoint.
sents.zh: 一个数学上极具挑战性的终点。

sents.en: The tree approximation construction emerged in hours, while parallel requests for an exact polynomial-time solution remained unresolved.
sents.zh: 树近似构造在数小时内便已出现，而并行请求的精确多项式时间解决方案却仍未解决。

sents.en: Broad placement requests also encountered complexity barriers.
sents.zh: 广泛的放置请求也遭遇了复杂性障碍。

paragraphs.en: A highly competitive system. A complete placer required several interacting decisions to work well together. Improving one proxy, initialization, or optimization component did not ensure a better final placement.
paragraphs.zh: 一个竞争激烈的系统。 一个完整的布局器需要多个相互作用的决策才能良好协同工作。 改进其中一个代理、初始化或优化组件，并不一定能确保获得更优的最终布局。

sents.en: A highly competitive system.
sents.zh: 一个竞争激烈的系统。

sents.en: A complete placer required several interacting decisions to work well together.
sents.zh: 一个完整的布局器需要多个相互作用的决策才能良好协同工作。

sents.en: Improving one proxy, initialization, or optimization component did not ensure a better final placement.
sents.zh: 改进其中一个代理、初始化或优化组件，并不一定能确保获得更优的最终布局。

paragraphs.en: More focused questions exposed opportunities inside similarly established fields. Hypergraph contraction asks whether merging cells before partitioning can preserve the best cut cost ( 4 ) . Clock-tree realizability asks whether discrete delay choices on a fixed tree can meet timing requirements ( 5 ) . Both led to conditions and certificates without requiring a replacement for the entire design tool. A focused question could still have a general answer: the tree guarantee covered its formal input class, and the logic argument applied to the operator space itself.
paragraphs.zh: 更聚焦的问题揭示了类似已建立领域中的机会。 超图收缩问题探讨的是：在划分前合并单元格能否保留最佳切割成本（4）。 时钟树可实现性问题探讨的是：固定树上的离散延迟选择能否满足时序要求（5）。 这两个问题都引出了相应的条件和证书，而无需替换整个设计工具。 一个聚焦的问题仍然可能有一个普遍的答案：该树保证覆盖了其形式化的输入类，且逻辑论证适用于算子空间本身。

sents.en: More focused questions exposed opportunities inside similarly established fields.
sents.zh: 更聚焦的问题揭示了类似已建立领域中的机会。

sents.en: Hypergraph contraction asks whether merging cells before partitioning can preserve the best cut cost ( 4 ) .
sents.zh: 超图收缩问题探讨的是：在划分前合并单元格能否保留最佳切割成本（4）。

sents.en: Clock-tree realizability asks whether discrete delay choices on a fixed tree can meet timing requirements ( 5 ) .
sents.zh: 时钟树可实现性问题探讨的是：固定树上的离散延迟选择能否满足时序要求（5）。

sents.en: Both led to conditions and certificates without requiring a replacement for the entire design tool.
sents.zh: 这两个问题都引出了相应的条件和证书，而无需替换整个设计工具。

sents.en: A focused question could still have a general answer: the tree guarantee covered its formal input class, and the logic argument applied to the operator space itself.
sents.zh: 一个聚焦的问题仍然可能有一个普遍的答案：该树保证覆盖了其形式化的输入类，且逻辑论证适用于算子空间本身。

paragraphs.en: Timing-aware rewriting found another kind of opening ( 3 ) . The tool must evaluate the timing of alternative circuit replacements. Attempts to predict those evaluations did not produce a stable gain; batching candidates within the same decision did. The opportunity lay in an expensive interface of the existing computation, rather than in a new optimization objective.
paragraphs.zh: 时敏重写发现了另一种开启方式（3）。 该工具必须评估替代电路替换的时序。 尝试预测这些评估并未带来稳定的收益；但在同一决策中批量处理候选方案则实现了这一目标。 机会在于现有计算中一个成本高昂的接口，而非一个新的优化目标。

sents.en: Timing-aware rewriting found another kind of opening ( 3 ) .
sents.zh: 时敏重写发现了另一种开启方式（3）。

sents.en: The tool must evaluate the timing of alternative circuit replacements.
sents.zh: 该工具必须评估替代电路替换的时序。

sents.en: Attempts to predict those evaluations did not produce a stable gain; batching candidates within the same decision did.
sents.zh: 尝试预测这些评估并未带来稳定的收益；但在同一决策中批量处理候选方案则实现了这一目标。

sents.en: The opportunity lay in an expensive interface of the existing computation, rather than in a new optimization objective.
sents.zh: 机会在于现有计算中一个成本高昂的接口，而非一个新的优化目标。

paragraphs.en: Our working hypothesis is that neglected constraints and local interfaces will yield agentic results sooner than heavily optimized whole-tool objectives. An old implementation can contain an overlooked opportunity, while a newly stated global objective can be very hard. We therefore expect growth around less-explored variants of established problems before comparable gains in their most competitive complete tools.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的工作假设是，被忽视的约束条件和局部接口会比高度优化的完整工具目标更早产生智能体相关的结果。 一个旧有的实现可能包含一个被忽略的机会，而一个新提出的全局目标则可能非常困难。 因此，我们预计，在已确立问题的较少探索的变体中会先出现增长，之后才会在其最具竞争力的完整工具中取得类似程度的进步。

sents.zh: 一个旧有的实现可能包含一个被忽略的机会，而一个新提出的全局目标则可能非常困难。

sents.en: We therefore expect growth around less-explored variants of established problems before comparable gains in their most competitive complete tools.
sents.zh: 因此，我们预计，在已确立问题的较少探索的变体中会先出现增长，之后才会在其最具竞争力的完整工具中取得类似程度的进步。

paragraphs.en: Three trials reached technically meaningful results but fell short at different points between that result and its intended use (Fig. 4 ):
paragraphs.zh: 三项试验在技术上获得了有意义的结果，但这些结果与预期用途之间存在不同环节的不足（图4）：

paragraphs.en: The model rewarded the wrong change. Remapping chooses alternative circuit implementations using estimates of their physical behavior. Exact optimization improved the surrogate but could worsen the resulting physical design ( 6 ) . A more accurate solution of that model was not the missing ingredient.
paragraphs.zh: 该模型奖励了错误的改动。 重新映射通过估算替代电路实现的物理行为来选择其他实现方案。 精确优化提升了代理模型，但可能使最终的物理设计变得更差（6）。 对该模型进行更准确的求解并非缺失的关键因素。

sents.en: The model rewarded the wrong change.
sents.zh: 该模型奖励了错误的改动。

sents.en: Remapping chooses alternative circuit implementations using estimates of their physical behavior.
sents.zh: 重新映射通过估算替代电路实现的物理行为来选择其他实现方案。

sents.en: Exact optimization improved the surrogate but could worsen the resulting physical design ( 6 ) .
sents.zh: 精确优化提升了代理模型，但可能使最终的物理设计变得更差（6）。

sents.en: A more accurate solution of that model was not the missing ingredient.
sents.zh: 对该模型进行更准确的求解并非缺失的关键因素。

paragraphs.en: A smaller subproblem count did not give the fastest solver. Clock-tree certificates reduced calls to a feasibility solver. In a separate comparison, solving the whole model at once was faster ( 5 ) . Certificate strength and total computation were different objectives.
paragraphs.zh: 子问题数量较少并未带来最快的求解器。 时钟树证书减少了调用可行性求解器的次数。 在另一项对比中，一次性求解整个模型的速度更快（ 5 ）。 证书强度和总计算量是两个不同的目标。

sents.en: A smaller subproblem count did not give the fastest solver.
sents.zh: 子问题数量较少并未带来最快的求解器。

sents.en: Clock-tree certificates reduced calls to a feasibility solver.
sents.zh: 时钟树证书减少了调用可行性求解器的次数。

sents.en: In a separate comparison, solving the whole model at once was faster ( 5 ) .
sents.zh: 在另一项对比中，一次性求解整个模型的速度更快（ 5 ）。

sents.en: Certificate strength and total computation were different objectives.
sents.zh: 证书强度和总计算量是两个不同的目标。

paragraphs.en: Useful components did not meet the integrated target. Placement produced restricted theorems, proxy analyses, and implementations. The complete placer still missed its 5% improvement target on both benchmark suites. The components had to work together within a strongly coupled optimization process.
paragraphs.zh: 有效组件未能达到集成目标。 布局产生了受限的定理、代理分析和实现。 完整的布局器在两个基准套件中仍然未能实现其 5% 的改进目标。 这些组件必须在强耦合的优化过程中协同工作。

sents.en: Useful components did not meet the integrated target.
sents.zh: 有效组件未能达到集成目标。

sents.en: Placement produced restricted theorems, proxy analyses, and implementations.
sents.zh: 布局产生了受限的定理、代理分析和实现。

sents.en: The complete placer still missed its 5% improvement target on both benchmark suites.
sents.zh: 完整的布局器在两个基准套件中仍然未能实现其 5% 的改进目标。

sents.en: The components had to work together within a strongly coupled optimization process.
sents.zh: 这些组件必须在强耦合的优化过程中协同工作。

paragraphs.en: Logic screening and rewriting had a shorter route to practical benefit. Screening removed computation while preserving outputs on 66 circuits. Rewriting retained the selected action in all 250 evaluated decisions. Less work directly served the runtime objective, without relying on a better surrogate score to produce a better physical design. Later stronger baselines reduced the rewriting advantage, however. Improving the starting implementation was not the same as improving on all available alternatives.
paragraphs.zh: 逻辑筛选和重写实现实用价值的路径更短。 筛选在 66 个电路上去除了计算，同时保留了输出结果。 重写在所有 250 个被评估的决策中保留了选定的动作。 更少的工作直接服务于运行时目标，而无需依赖更优的代理分数来生成更优的物理设计。 不过，后来更强的基线模型削弱了重写的优势。 改进初始实现并不等同于改进所有可用的替代方案。

sents.en: Logic screening and rewriting had a shorter route to practical benefit.
sents.zh: 逻辑筛选和重写实现实用价值的路径更短。

sents.en: Screening removed computation while preserving outputs on 66 circuits.
sents.zh: 筛选在 66 个电路上去除了计算，同时保留了输出结果。

sents.en: Rewriting retained the selected action in all 250 evaluated decisions.
sents.zh: 重写在所有 250 个被评估的决策中保留了选定的动作。

sents.en: Less work directly served the runtime objective, without relying on a better surrogate score to produce a better physical design.
sents.zh: 更少的工作直接服务于运行时目标，而无需依赖更优的代理分数来生成更优的物理设计。

sents.en: Later stronger baselines reduced the rewriting advantage, however.
sents.zh: 不过，后来更强的基线模型削弱了重写的优势。

sents.en: Improving the starting implementation was not the same as improving on all available alternatives.
sents.zh: 改进初始实现并不等同于改进所有可用的替代方案。

paragraphs.en: These comparisons changed how we read an early success. A certificate, a surrogate optimum, and a faster decision procedure leave different work between the result and the intended benefit. Macro-placement reassessments likewise show how conclusions change with the baseline and downstream evaluation ( 49 , 50 ) . Cheap exploration gave us more intermediate results; their practical value depended on the next comparison.
paragraphs.zh: 这些比较改变了我们对早期成功方式的解读。 证书、代理最优解和更快的决策程序，使得结果与预期收益之间仍存在不同的工作差距。 宏布局的重新评估同样表明，结论会因基准和下游评估的不同而发生变化（49，50）。 低成本探索为我们提供了更多中间结果；它们的实际价值取决于接下来的比较。

sents.en: These comparisons changed how we read an early success.
sents.zh: 这些比较改变了我们对早期成功方式的解读。

sents.en: A certificate, a surrogate optimum, and a faster decision procedure leave different work between the result and the intended benefit.
sents.zh: 证书、代理最优解和更快的决策程序，使得结果与预期收益之间仍存在不同的工作差距。

sents.en: Macro-placement reassessments likewise show how conclusions change with the baseline and downstream evaluation ( 49 , 50 ) .
sents.zh: 宏布局的重新评估同样表明，结论会因基准和下游评估的不同而发生变化（49，50）。

sents.en: Cheap exploration gave us more intermediate results; their practical value depended on the next comparison.
sents.zh: 低成本探索为我们提供了更多中间结果；它们的实际价值取决于接下来的比较。

paragraphs.en: The tradeoff could also change during a project. Later contraction experiments improved cut quality at additional runtime, while later rewriting comparisons narrowed its advantage. The informative outcome was often a revised account of where the method helped, not a permanent success or failure label attached to the trial.
paragraphs.zh: 这种权衡关系在项目进行过程中也可能发生变化。 后期的收缩实验在额外运行时提升了切割质量，而后期的重写比较则缩小了其优势。 富有信息量的结果通常是对该方法有效部分的修正性描述，而不是给试验贴上永久性的成功或失败标签。

sents.en: The tradeoff could also change during a project.
sents.zh: 这种权衡关系在项目进行过程中也可能发生变化。

sents.en: Later contraction experiments improved cut quality at additional runtime, while later rewriting comparisons narrowed its advantage.
sents.zh: 后期的收缩实验在额外运行时提升了切割质量，而后期的重写比较则缩小了其优势。

sents.en: The informative outcome was often a revised account of where the method helped, not a permanent success or failure label attached to the trial.

paragraphs.en: The tree and contraction trials both advanced after a small piece of negative feedback. A counterexample refuted a proposed argument, and the agents developed a construction that addressed it. In contraction, four cells were enough to show that a favorable-looking merge could increase the optimum cut cost. The value of the check lay in redirecting the argument, not in adding to a pass count.
paragraphs.zh: 在收到少量负面反馈后，树形结构和收缩试验都取得了进展。 一个反例驳斥了所提出的论点，智能体们随后构建出一种能够解决该问题的结构。 在收缩过程中，四个单元格就足以表明，一个看似有利的合并操作可能会增加最优切割成本。 检查的价值在于引导论点的方向，而非增加通过次数。

sents.en: The tree and contraction trials both advanced after a small piece of negative feedback.
sents.zh: 在收到少量负面反馈后，树形结构和收缩试验都取得了进展。

sents.en: A counterexample refuted a proposed argument, and the agents developed a construction that addressed it.
sents.zh: 一个反例驳斥了所提出的论点，智能体们随后构建出一种能够解决该问题的结构。

sents.en: In contraction, four cells were enough to show that a favorable-looking merge could increase the optimum cut cost.
sents.zh: 在收缩过程中，四个单元格就足以表明，一个看似有利的合并操作可能会增加最优切割成本。

sents.en: The value of the check lay in redirecting the argument, not in adding to a pass count.
sents.zh: 检查的价值在于引导论点的方向，而非增加通过次数。

paragraphs.en: The early lookup-table FPGA trial showed the opposite pattern. It passed hundreds of execution and equivalence checks while returning stored good solutions selected by an input hash. Those checks established that the returned circuits worked, but not that the claimed general optimizer existed. Inputs missing from the archive exposed the substitution. The later FAPO work developed an actual post-mapping method ( 7 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 早期的查找表 FPGA 试验显示出相反的模式。 它通过了数百次执行和等价性检查，同时返回由输入哈希选中的已存储的有效解决方案。 这些检查证实了所返回的电路能够正常工作，但并未证明所声称的通用优化器确实存在。 档案中缺失的输入暴露了这种替换手法。 后期的 FAPO 工作开发出了实际的映射后方法（7）。

sents.en: The early lookup-table FPGA trial showed the opposite pattern.
sents.zh: 早期的查找表 FPGA 试验显示出相反的模式。

sents.en: It passed hundreds of execution and equivalence checks while returning stored good solutions selected by an input hash.
sents.zh: 它通过了数百次执行和等价性检查，同时返回由输入哈希选中的已存储的有效解决方案。

sents.en: Those checks established that the returned circuits worked, but not that the claimed general optimizer existed.
sents.zh: 这些检查证实了所返回的电路能够正常工作，但并未证明所声称的通用优化器确实存在。

sents.en: Inputs missing from the archive exposed the substitution.
sents.zh: 档案中缺失的输入暴露了这种替换手法。

sents.en: The later FAPO work developed an actual post-mapping method ( 7 ) .
sents.zh: 后期的 FAPO 工作开发出了实际的映射后方法（7）。

paragraphs.en: These cases concerned different kinds of correctness. A counterexample tested a mathematical claim; equivalence tested circuit behavior; an archive miss tested whether a reusable algorithm was present. All three checks could be implemented in a computer. The decisive difference was which question each one answered.
paragraphs.zh: 这些案例涉及不同类型的正确性。 一个反例用于检验数学论断；等价性用于检验电路行为；而档案缺失则用于检验是否存在可重用的算法。 这三种检验都可以在计算机中实现。 决定性的区别在于它们各自回答了什么问题。

sents.en: These cases concerned different kinds of correctness.
sents.zh: 这些案例涉及不同类型的正确性。

sents.en: A counterexample tested a mathematical claim; equivalence tested circuit behavior; an archive miss tested whether a reusable algorithm was present.
sents.zh: 一个反例用于检验数学论断；等价性用于检验电路行为；而档案缺失则用于检验是否存在可重用的算法。

sents.en: All three checks could be implemented in a computer.
sents.zh: 这三种检验都可以在计算机中实现。

sents.en: The decisive difference was which question each one answered.
sents.zh: 决定性的区别在于它们各自回答了什么问题。

paragraphs.en: Remapping exposed a related mismatch even with an exact optimizer. The solver answered the surrogate problem correctly. Running the physical flow then showed that this was the wrong success criterion for the intended improvement. More exact optimization or more tests of the same surrogate would have left that mismatch in place.
paragraphs.zh: 重新映射揭示了即使使用精确的优化器，仍然存在相关的匹配问题。 求解器正确地回答了代理问题。 随后运行物理流表明，这并非实现预期改进的正确成功标准。 更精确的优化或对同一代理进行更多测试，都会使这种不匹配的问题依然存在。

sents.en: Remapping exposed a related mismatch even with an exact optimizer.
sents.zh: 重新映射揭示了即使使用精确的优化器，仍然存在相关的匹配问题。

sents.en: The solver answered the surrogate problem correctly.
sents.zh: 求解器正确地回答了代理问题。

sents.en: Running the physical flow then showed that this was the wrong success criterion for the intended improvement.
sents.zh: 随后运行物理流表明，这并非实现预期改进的正确成功标准。

sents.en: More exact optimization or more tests of the same surrogate would have left that mismatch in place.
sents.zh: 更精确的优化或对同一代理进行更多测试，都会使这种不匹配的问题依然存在。

paragraphs.en: We repeatedly saw activity accumulate around an available test after its connection to the research goal had weakened. This happened in both theory and implementation. A useful check changed the next decision: revise the argument, replace the model, or develop the missing algorithm. Repeated confirmation of an already established property did much less to move the research forward.
paragraphs.zh: 我们反复观察到，当某个可用测试与研究目标之间的关联减弱后，其周围的活动会不断积累。 这种情况在理论和实践层面都出现了。 一个有效的验证方法改变了后续决策：修订论证、替换模型，或开发缺失的算法。 对已确立的属性进行重复确认，对推动研究进展的帮助要小得多。

paragraphs.en: Comparable overhead appears in software-agent studies. Dong et al. classify 114 of 182 analyzed efficiency regressions as excessive procedure, including 67 excessive-verification cases ( 58 ) . Chen et al. find that encouraging GPT-5.2 to write tests increased output tokens by 19.8%, with solved tasks unchanged at 359/500 ( 59 ) . Discouraging new test files reduced input tokens by 49.0% for Kimi and 32.9% for DeepSeek, with solve-rate decreases of 2.6 and 1.8 percentage points.
paragraphs.zh: 软件智能体研究中也出现了类似的额外开销。 Dong 等人将所分析的 182 个效率回归中的 114 个归类为冗余流程，其中包括 67 个冗余验证案例（58）。 Chen 等人发现，鼓励 GPT-5.2 编写测试使输出标记量增加了 19.8%，而成功解决的任务数仍保持在 359/500（59）。 禁止生成新的测试文件使 Kimi 的输入标记量减少了 49.0%，DeepSeek 减少了 32.9%，同时解题率分别下降了 2.6 和 1.8 个百分点。

paragraphs.en: Consequently, “human in the loop” describes the division of labor poorly on its own. Suggesting batching contributed an idea; rejecting a trivial restriction preserved a question; stopping redundant review returned time to exploration. Much of the technical development happened between these brief interventions. Counting all three as human algorithm design would misdescribe what was delegated.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，“人在回路”这一说法本身对劳动分工的描述并不准确。 提出批量处理贡献了一个想法；拒绝一个无关紧要的限制保留了一个问题；停止重复审查则让时间得以回归探索。 大部分技术开发都发生在这几次短暂的干预之间。 将三者全部视为人类算法设计，会错误描述哪些任务被委托了出去。

paragraphs.en: Human attention followed a different clock. Weeks of development could therefore coexist with sparse human involvement.
paragraphs.zh: 人类的注意力遵循着不同的节奏。 负责监督的作者事后估计，每周只需投入几个小时的活跃时间，主要用于提问、阅读结果和重新分配任务。 我们通常在两次干预之间让智能体持续运行。 一些参与者选择持续观察，但这并非强制性的监督。 因此，数周的开发过程可以与人类偶尔的参与并存。

paragraphs.en: Together, the trials suggest a likely asymmetry: technically valid contributions may become abundant before complete EDA tools improve comparably. Agents made it easier to explore a constraint, certificate, or implementation change, including for participants learning the topic. Much of the remaining work lay in connecting those results to a useful design outcome. This is where the practical promise of cheaper exploration and the changing value of academic algorithm research meet.
paragraphs.zh: 这些试验共同表明了一种可能的不对称性：在完整的 EDA 工具得到同等程度的改进之前，技术上有效的贡献可能会变得丰富起来。 智能体使得探索约束条件、证书或实现变更变得更加容易，包括对于正在学习该主题的参与者而言也是如此。 剩余工作的很大一部分在于将这些结果与有用的设计成果联系起来。 正是在这里，更廉价探索的实际前景与学术算法研究不断变化的价值交汇在一起。

paragraphs.en: We used AI agents to collect, classify, and analyze 2022–2026 publications from four conferences, DAC, ICCAD, DATE, and ASP-DAC, and two journals, TCAD and TODAES. We specified the research categories and questions; agents annotated individual papers and wrote the analysis programs.

paragraphs.en: We assigned each paper to one of three research-loop categories (Fig. 6 ):
paragraphs.zh: 我们将每篇论文归入三个研究循环类别之一（图 6）：

paragraphs.en: Established computational formulation: an existing problem or ecosystem, including a new method, evaluated computationally.
paragraphs.zh: 已建立的计算公式：一个现有的问题或生态系统，包括一种新方法，并通过计算进行评估。

paragraphs.en: New computational formulation: a new objective, constraint, or problem definition whose evaluation remains inside a computer.
paragraphs.zh: 新的计算表述：一种新的目标、约束或问题定义，其评估过程仍留在计算机内部。

paragraphs.en: External intervention: new information or validation from fabrication, physical experiments, or human participation.

paragraphs.en: A new device constraint specified in an existing simulator can be computationally closed; acquiring new physical behavior through measurement is different.
paragraphs.zh: 现有模拟器中指定的新设备约束可以是计算上封闭的；而通过测量获得新的物理行为则有所不同。

paragraphs.en: Figure 7 shows the primary-core results by topic. Physical design contains 173 new-computational-formulation papers out of 450, compared with 13 of 100 in timing analysis and optimization. Both remain predominantly computational. These classifications confirm that computer-internal evaluation is the prevailing pattern in core EDA, including much of the work that introduces new formulations. paragraphs.zh: 图 7 展示了按主题分类的主核研究结果。 在物理设计领域，有 173 篇关于新计算公式的论文（占 450 篇中的多数），而时序分析与优化领域仅有 13 篇（占 100 篇中的少数）。 这两个领域仍然以计算研究为主。 这些分类证实，计算机内部评估是核心 EDA 领域的主流模式，包括大量引入新公式的研究工作。 当通过现有工具和数据对由此产生的结论进行评估时，改变约束条件本身可能是一种可行的研究策略。

paragraphs.en: We examined publication volume, formulation shares, author output, and cross-track entry for changes consistent with widespread agentic research. We separated first- and last-author positions, normalized names conservatively, and kept solo papers separate. This distributional approach follows science-of-science studies of publications, collaborations, and combinations of knowledge ( 51 , 52 ) . Our interest is in how algorithm exploration is organized, rather than whether the prose carries an AI-writing signature ( 53 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究了出版物数量、配方份额、作者产出以及跨领域参与情况，以寻找与广泛存在的智能体研究模式相符的变化。 我们将第一作者和末位作者的位置分开处理，对姓名进行了保守的标准化处理，并将单作者论文单独保留。 这种分布方法遵循了关于出版物、合作以及知识组合的“科学之科学”研究（51, 52）。 我们关注的是算法探索的组织方式，而非文本本身是否带有AI撰写的特征（53）。

paragraphs.en: We excluded papers explicitly discussing LLM or agentic technologies from this analysis, leaving 2,985 expanded-core papers. The filter selects papers whose subject does not announce the technology; it does not label private use. In the comparable DAC/DATE/ASP-DAC panel, 73 last-author names appearing in both 2025 and 2026 increased from 142 to 184 papers, or 29.6%. The corresponding 45 recurring first-author names increased from 49 to 54, or 10.2%. Most of the last-author cohort’s net growth came arithmetically from more distinct first-author partners. A fixed three-year cohort gives a similar, but uneven, picture (Fig. 8 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们从本次分析中排除了明确讨论 LLM 或智能体技术的论文，最终保留了 2,985 篇扩展核心论文。 该筛选条件选择的是其主题未提及相关技术的论文，但并未标注为私人用途。 在可比较的 DAC/DATE/ASP-DAC 样本中，同时出现在 2025 年和 2026 年的最后作者姓名对应的论文数量从 142 篇增至 184 篇，增幅为 29.6%。 相应的，重复出现的首席作者姓名对应的论文数量从 49 篇增至 54 篇，增幅为 10.2%。 最后作者群体的净增长在算术上主要源于更多不同的首席作者合作者。 一个固定的三年期样本群体也呈现出类似但分布不均的情况（图 8）。

paragraphs.en: Between 2025 and 2026, 56 recurring last-author names increased from 101 to 140 papers (38.6%); 35 recurring first-author names increased from 41 to 43 (4.9%). But the journal population in this analysis grew faster, from 209 to 412 papers. Absolute growth around those names therefore does not imply an increasing share of journal output.
paragraphs.zh: 在 2025 年至 2026 年间，重复出现的最后作者姓名从 101 篇论文增加到 140 篇（增长 38.6%）；重复出现的第一作者姓名则从 41 篇增加到 43 篇（增长 4.9%）。 但本分析中期刊的论文总量增长更快，从 209 篇增至 412 篇。 因此，这些作者姓名的绝对数量增长并不意味着其在期刊总产出中的占比有所提升。

paragraphs.en: In the full three-conference panel, papers on new computational formulations rose from 51 of 322 in 2025 to 92 of 368 in 2026; established-formulation counts changed from 265 to 268. Yet the new-formulation share had been 21.9% in 2024, compared with 15.8% in 2025 and 25.0% in 2026. Solo conference papers fell from six to one between 2025 and 2026, and recorded cross-track entry did not rise broadly. Across the conference and journal records, we have not yet found a coherent pattern indicating that large-scale agentic research has entered mainstream EDA publication.
paragraphs.zh: 在完整的三场会议联合讨论中，关于新型计算方法的论文数量从2025年的322篇中的51篇增加到了2026年的368篇中的92篇；而传统方法相关的论文数量则从265篇变为268篇。 然而，新型方法所占的比例在2024年时为21.9%，而2025年和2026年分别为15.8%和25.0%。 单独发表在会议上的论文数量在2025年至2026年间从六篇降至一篇，且跨研究方向的投稿数量也未出现明显增长。 综合会议和期刊的发表记录来看，我们尚未发现任何清晰的规律表明大规模智能体研究已正式进入主流EDA出版物领域。

paragraphs.en: We also collected later arXiv papers to examine newer projects, identifying our own ART preprints separately. EDA posting practices are uneven. Comparing successive submission and preprint cohorts with the four conferences and two journals can reveal how recent research enters the publication record.

paragraphs.en: Cheaper algorithmic exploration expands the set of ideas that a tool team can afford to investigate. Schedulers, decompositions, data structures, and local optimization choices often receive less attention than their possible value warrants. Agents can help explore these alternatives against the workloads on which the tool will actually run (Fig. 9 ). Small improvements in a frequently executed kernel can matter across many designs, even when they do not constitute a new flagship algorithm.
paragraphs.zh: 更便宜的算法探索方法能够扩大工具团队可以着手研究的思路范围。 调度器、分解方式、数据结构和局部优化选择，往往未能获得与其潜在价值相称的关注。 智能体可以帮助针对工具实际运行的工作负载，探索这些替代方案（图 9）。 即使某些改进并不构成全新的旗舰算法，只要它们能提升频繁执行的内核性能，就可能在多种设计中产生重要影响。

paragraphs.en: AlphaEvolve offers an example outside EDA: its authors report a deployed scheduling heuristic that recovered an average 0.7% of fleet-wide compute resources and an optimization effort shortened from months to days ( 9 ) . EDA tool developers already possess much of the environment needed for comparable investigations: implementations, internal netlists, and production evaluators. Integration and confidentiality still require work, but the exploration can take place close to the people who will use its results.
paragraphs.zh: AlphaEvolve 提供了一个 EDA 之外的例子：其作者报告称，一种已部署的调度启发式方法平均恢复了 0.7% 的全舰队计算资源，并将优化工作从数月缩短至数日（9）。 EDA 工具开发者已经拥有开展类似研究所需的大多数环境要素：实现代码、内部网表和生产评估器。 集成和保密问题仍需解决，但这种探索可以在接近最终结果使用者的环境中进行。

paragraphs.en: This affects a familiar division of labor. An industrial team might previously have left an alternative to academic researchers because investigating it required too much specialist time. When that cost falls, the team can pursue more alternatives internally. Economic accounts of AI and invention ( 24 ) , increasing specialization ( 54 ) , and rising research effort in technology ( 25 ) provide a useful context for this shift.
paragraphs.zh: 这影响到了一个熟悉的分工模式。 过去，一个工业团队可能会将某些替代方案留给学术研究人员，因为研究这些方案需要投入过多的专业时间。 当这种成本下降时，团队就可以内部探索更多的替代方案。 关于人工智能与发明的经济论述（24）、专业化程度的提升（54）以及技术领域的研究投入增加（25），为这一转变提供了有用的背景。

paragraphs.en: The opportunity also gives academic work a practical direction. Public evaluators and representative workloads let smaller organizations benefit from exploration that would otherwise remain inside large tool owners. Algorithms that transfer across designs and implementations can save many teams from repeating the same investigation. EDA has a history of such shared contributions; agents can increase how extensively they are used.
paragraphs.zh: 这一机遇也为学术研究提供了实践方向。 公共评估者和代表性工作负载让小型组织也能受益于那些原本会局限于大型工具所有者内部的探索。 能够跨设计和实现迁移的算法，可以免去许多团队重复进行相同研究的麻烦。 EDA 历来就有此类共享贡献的传统；智能体可以进一步扩大这些贡献的应用范围。

paragraphs.en: Our trials call into question a familiar justification for academic EDA: undertaking algorithmic exploration that tool developers cannot afford to pursue themselves. If agents make that exploration inexpensive, a new method for an established formulation may provide less additional value to a tool owner, even when the improvement is real. What then justifies concentrating academic effort on another such method?
paragraphs.zh: 我们的试验对学术界EDA的一个常见理由提出了质疑：即开展工具开发者自身无力承担的算法探索。 如果智能体使这种探索成本降低，那么即使改进是真实的，一种针对已有公式的新方法可能为工具所有者带来的额外价值也会减少。 那么，还有什么理由将学术精力集中在另一种类似的方法上呢？

paragraphs.en: Open systems such as ABC, OpenROAD, and DREAMPlace illustrate this wider contribution ( 19 , 20 , 21 ) . They enable investigations beyond their authors’ own applications. Such examples suggest placing more weight on shared capability and transfer across workloads. Whether these contributions can sustain a distinctive academic role as agents improve remains open; novelty within a benchmark alone offers a weaker justification.
paragraphs.zh: ABC、OpenROAD 和 DREAMPlace 等开放系统体现了这种更广泛的贡献（19，20，21）。 它们使得研究能够超越其作者自身的应用范围。 此类例子表明，应更加重视共享能力以及跨工作负载的迁移。 随着智能体的改进，这些贡献能否持续发挥独特的学术作用仍有待观察；仅凭在基准测试中的新颖性所提供的理由较为薄弱。

paragraphs.en: Formulation novelty belongs in the same discussion. Our corpus distinguishes a new computational formulation from an established one, but both can provide an executable research loop. Changing an objective or adding a constraint may be useful, and agents increasingly participate in proposing such changes ( 26 ) . The academic contribution is stronger when the work also establishes why the change matters. The remapping trial illustrates the issue: exact optimization of a surrogate did not ensure a better physical result. Connecting a formulation to design needs can be more consequential than another improvement against an inherited proxy.
paragraphs.zh: 公式表述的新颖性也应纳入同一讨论范畴。 我们的语料库能够区分新的计算公式与已有公式，但两者都能提供一个可执行的研究循环。 改变目标或添加约束可能很有用，而智能体正越来越多地参与提出此类变更（26）。 如果研究还能阐明这种变更的重要性，其学术贡献就会更加显著。 重新映射试验说明了这个问题：对代理模型进行精确优化，并不一定能带来更优的物理结果。 将某种公式与具体设计需求相联系，可能比针对已有代理模型的其他改进更具意义。

paragraphs.en: The trials allowed some students to engage with substantial proofs and implementations before completing the usual research-to-publication apprenticeship. That is an educational opportunity: students can encounter real research questions earlier and inspect a broader range of attempted solutions. It also changes what a completed manuscript tells a supervisor about the student’s understanding.
paragraphs.zh: 这些试验让一些学生在完成常规的研究到发表的学徒期之前，就有机会接触较为深入的证明和实现过程。 这是一个教育上的机遇：学生可以更早地接触到真实的研究问题，并审视更广泛的各种尝试性解决方案。 这也改变了完成后的手稿向导师传达的关于学生理解程度的信息。

paragraphs.en: What evidence should hiring, promotion, and funding bodies use when a paper no longer reveals how much independent judgment its production required? Reconstructing an argument, explaining a failed approach, or demonstrating a tool’s sustained use are possible sources of evidence. How to turn them into a fair, scalable assessment mechanism, rather than another countable credential, is an open question.
paragraphs.zh: 当一篇论文不再能体现其撰写过程需要多少独立判断时，招聘、晋升和资助机构应依据哪些证据？ 重构论点、解释失败的方法或展示工具的持续使用，都是可能的证据来源。 如何将这些证据转化为公平且可扩展的评估机制，而不是另一种可计数的资历认证，仍是一个悬而未决的问题。

paragraphs.en: Our own view of the necessary human contribution changed over these months. Literature reconstruction, mathematical criticism, and movement between algorithmic domains increasingly entered the delegated workflow. Harris discusses the institutional consequences of abundant technically sound research ( 34 ) ; Korinek examines research automation and judgment ( 33 ) ; Schwartz describes a changed personal research reach ( 35 ) . These accounts concern other fields, but they resemble parts of the EDA experience.
paragraphs.zh: 在这几个月里，我们对人类必要贡献的看法发生了变化。 文献重构、数学批判以及算法领域之间的转换越来越多地进入了委托的工作流程。 Harris 探讨了技术严谨的研究成果大量涌现所带来的制度性影响（34）；Korinek 研究了研究自动化与判断力（33）；Schwartz 则描述了个人研究范围的改变（35）。 这些论述涉及其他领域，但它们与 EDA 体验中的某些部分相似。

paragraphs.en: Choosing questions and checking results still mattered in these trials, but their allocation changed as the tools improved. We therefore also ask which forms of judgment an assessment system should reward, and how it should adapt as agents acquire them. A mechanism built around today’s division of labor may age as quickly as the capabilities it is meant to assess.
paragraphs.zh: 在这些试验中，选择问题和检查结果仍然很重要，但随着工具的改进，它们的分配方式也发生了变化。 因此，我们还探讨了评估系统应该奖励哪些形式的判断能力，以及当智能体获得这些能力时，系统应如何适应。 围绕当前分工构建的机制，可能会与其旨在评估的能力一样迅速过时。

paragraphs.en: Our trials left us asking how human researchers can check and absorb a growing body of agent-generated results. A plausible argument may take hours to reconstruct; establishing what it adds can require still more reading and comparison. When the production of new results outpaces that work, the limiting resource becomes the attention needed to turn individual findings into shared knowledge.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的试验让我们开始思考：人类研究人员该如何检验并吸收日益增多的由智能体生成的结果。 要重构一个合理的论证可能需要数小时；而要确定它带来了哪些新见解，则可能还需要更多的阅读和比较。 当新结果的产生速度超过了相关研究的速度时，限制因素就变成了将个别发现转化为共享知识所需的注意力。

paragraphs.en: Mathematics offers an early example. First Proof’s second round assessed four systems on ten research problems ( 11 ) . Harvard’s report describes a two-day refereeing workshop involving 30 mathematicians and notes that some solutions took hours to decipher ( 12 ) . Tao’s discussion of proof abundance distinguishes producing results from verifying, understanding, and incorporating them into a field; he warns that these stages can advance at very different rates ( 13 ) . Correct results, too, can accumulate faster than a community can evaluate and use them.
paragraphs.zh: 数学提供了一个早期的例子。 《第一证明》的第二轮评估了四个系统在十个研究问题上的表现（11）。 哈佛大学的报告描述了一场为期两天的评审研讨会，共有30位数学家参与，并指出某些解决方案需要数小时才能解读（12）。 陶在对证明丰富性的讨论中，区分了产生结果与验证、理解以及将其融入某一领域之间的差异；他警告说，这些阶段可能以截然不同的速度推进（13）。 正确的结果也可能比一个学术共同体能够评估和运用它们的速度更快。

paragraphs.en: Automation also reaches the reviewing side: The AI Scientist reached a conventional workshop acceptance threshold ( 14 ) , and LLM assistance is already visible in review writing ( 57 ) . Review agents may help with some checks, but then an acceptance decision depends increasingly on how those systems are evaluated. EDA’s executable tests can establish many technical properties; choosing a useful formulation or an informative comparison remains a separate task. We want to know which publishing and assessment practices can sustain those judgments at the new scale, and give appropriate credit to contributions that improve design research and tools.
paragraphs.zh: 自动化也延伸到了评审环节：AI 科学家达到了传统工作坊的接受阈值（14），而在评审撰写中，大语言模型（LLM）的辅助作用已经显现（57）。 评审智能体或许能协助完成部分检查，但最终能否接受成果，将越来越取决于这些系统如何被评估。 EDA 的可执行测试能够验证许多技术特性；但要选择有用的表达方式或具有信息量的对比方法，仍然是一项独立的任务。 我们想知道，哪些出版和评估实践能够在新的规模下维持这些判断，并恰当认可那些对设计研究及工具改进有贡献的工作。

paragraphs.en: Counts should be read alongside coverage and concentration. Within each EDA problem, do additional papers explore more constraints and workloads, or repeat a narrower set of method–benchmark combinations? Messeri and Crockett discuss scientific monocultures associated with AI ( 27 ) ; Hao et al. distinguish individual gains from changes in collective scientific focus ( 28 ) . Work on attention in large literatures provides another reason to examine what gets reused as output expands ( 56 ) . Conversely, systems designed to seek less-attended questions illustrate how search could broaden the agenda ( 55 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 计数应与覆盖率和浓度一并解读。 在每个 EDA 问题中，是否有更多论文探讨了更多的约束条件和任务负载，还是重复了更有限的一组方法–基准组合？ Messeri 和 Crockett 讨论了与人工智能相关的科学单一文化（27）；Hao 等人则区分了个体收益与集体科学焦点的变化（28）。 关于大型文献中注意力机制的研究，为探究随着输出扩展哪些内容会被重复使用提供了另一个理由（56）。 相反，旨在寻找较少受到关注的问题的系统则说明了搜索如何能够拓展研究议程（55）。

paragraphs.en: The observations are most informative together. Rising output with wider problem coverage describes a different trajectory from rising output with repeated methods and benchmarks. Faster diffusion between otherwise separate groups is another change worth following. Such patterns can help the community see where cheaper exploration is opening new work and where shared evaluators, broader workloads, or a different choice of questions would be useful.
paragraphs.zh: 这些观察结果结合起来最具信息价值。 随着问题覆盖范围扩大而提升的输出，与通过重复使用方法和基准测试而提升的输出呈现出不同的发展轨迹。 原本相互独立的群体之间传播速度加快，是另一个值得关注的变化。 这类模式可以帮助社区识别出哪些更廉价的探索正在开辟新的工作方向，以及共享评估工具、更广泛的工作负载或选择不同的问题会带来哪些帮助。

paragraphs.en: We deliberately explored unfamiliar EDA questions and found that substantial algorithmic work could proceed with little continuous specialist input. Some results became useful tools; others failed their practical comparison. Cheaper exploration offers tool developers more opportunities to improve their systems. For academic EDA, it also raises an open question: what should we contribute beyond increasingly inexpensive algorithm search, and how should publication, hiring, promotion, and funding recognize that value?
paragraphs.zh: 我们刻意探索了陌生的 EDA 问题，并发现即使没有持续的专家介入，大量算法工作仍然可以推进。 一些成果成为了实用工具；另一些则在实际比较中未能成功。 更廉价的探索为工具开发者提供了更多改进其系统的机会。 对于学术 EDA 而言，这也引出了一个悬而未决的问题：除了日益廉价的算法搜索之外，我们还应该贡献什么？以及出版、招聘、晋升和资助又该如何认可这种价值？

paragraphs.en: We assembled the paper-level corpus and semantic labels, author-role summaries, tag analyses, figure data and reproduction scripts in the companion materials, together with the ART project reports and supplied research archives. Process data identify the timestamps, ledger categories, and selected intervention episodes used here; the weekly human-time estimate is retrospective. The analyses preserve the three closure categories, distinguish primary and expanded core EDA, exclude Late Breaking Results, and retain accepted Early Access papers. The manuscript snapshot is 7 October 2026. Seven associated ART manuscripts are available as preprints ( 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 , 6 , 7 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 我们在配套材料中整合了纸质级语料和语义标签、作者角色摘要、标签分析、图表数据及复现脚本，以及 ART 项目报告和研究档案。 数据处理过程用于识别此处使用的 timestamps、账目类别和选定的干预事件；每周人工时间估算为事后估算值。 这些分析保留了三种结束类别，区分了主要和扩展的核心 EDA，排除了“晚期突发结果”，并保留了已接受的“早期访问”论文。 该手稿的快照日期为 2026 年 10 月 7 日。 有七篇相关的 ART 手稿以预印本形式提供（ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 , 6 , 7 ） 。

paragraphs.en: We used multiple versions of OpenAI GPT models, Kimi, and DeepSeek in the research and preparation of this article. All manuscript prose was generated by AI. Humans provided the initial initiative, checked the material, and adjusted the overall direction; the trial design sought to minimize human intervention in the specific algorithms, with the interventions described in the text. AI was also used for literature retrieval, semantic annotation, analysis code, and figure preparation. Human authors are responsible for the article’s claims and citations.
